what_happened.line: The School Committee approved an ice hockey trip to Waterville Valley, New Hampshire.
The committee heard the maintenance budget proposal, including expected rises in natural gas and electricity supply costs and a recommended increase to the emergency expenditure line.
The committee heard the nursing budget proposal; a state mentored school grant continues to fund some items, substitute nurses and screenings.
The committee waived the second reading of the service animals policy and of the section 3000 policies.
A calendar survey was set to stay open until the 12th, and a workshop on committee goals was set for November 17.

why_it_matters: Nursing and maintenance requests feed the school budget, which is largely paid from the town budget, mostly taxes; energy cost increases are one mechanism that can push the maintenance line up.
No budget totals were voted at this meeting, so these figures are proposals that can still change before any vote residents are asked to take.
